Key honest finding: quilt-Kuramoto is a SALVAGED ARCHIVE and its own docs/MISSING.md documents the harvest losses — the resolver's 253 FM independently cross-checks that gap list (12/12 spot-verified absent; ≥7 name MISSING.md-documented 404s; only 2/253 basename-recoverable). The fixable class is the 264 AMBIGUOUS bare-basename citations (8/8 spot-verified multi-repo): a basename-pinning pass = the resolver's AMBIGUOUS taxonomy applied as a doc lint.

All claims spot-verified by direct read vs indexed clone (HEAD 070159bf). Honest limits in-doc: shallow-HEAD index, PATH_PRECISE_ONLY advisory-only (49.2% FP), FM overlaps known archival loss (not a defect count).

Main untouched. Edge: quilt-Kuramoto → fleet-triage/resolver, PENDING → VERIFIED=1.0 on merge.
